summary: The candidate contains the issue-specific design: PDMux-active Marlin layers opt into lazily allocated workspaces keyed by the executing GPU stream, and active FP8/FP4/compressed-tensors/ModelOpt/GPTQ/AWQ Marlin call sites select those workspaces. On the recorded base, the candidate regression fails during collection because the selector is absent; at the exact candidate commit its host-side fallback, opt-in, sizing, and two-stream isolation cases pass on gfx950. This does not independently establish that the original NVIDIA SM80 green-context Marlin deadlock is fixed: the actual Marlin deep-queue test is skipped on ROCm and the canonical serving reproducer could not run without an NVIDIA A100/H100 and Qwen3.8-27B-FP8 weights. The candidate is therefore mechanism-supported but the original contract remains unverified in this review environment.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before regression evidence on recorded base: collection raises ImportError because get_marlin_workspace_for_forward is absent. This proves the base lacks the proposed isolation mechanism, but is not an end-to-end reproduction of the original CUDA deadlock. Raw output: reports/j-fa78cbfd550e/base_regression.log

Four host-side regression/boundary cases passed, including two real gfx950 GPU streams receiving distinct correctly sized workspaces. The sole actual Marlin deep-queue kernel test was skipped because ROCm cannot execute NVIDIA Marlin. Raw output: reports/j-fa78cbfd550e/candidate_regression.log
Existing FP8-Marlin logical output/bias-order unit regression remained passing; it does not execute the original concurrent CUDA/PDMux failure. Raw output: reports/j-fa78cbfd550e/fp8_regression.log

Independent source audit of remaining direct workspace consumers. Remaining matches were non-Marlin paths, per-call Marlin MoE allocation, or the separate multimodal-generation runtime outside the SRT PDMux scheduler contract. Evidence: reports/j-fa78cbfd550e/workspace_consumers_candidate.txt
Candidate changed Python sources and regression compile successfully from the repository source tree.

gpu_execution.evidence: AMD Instinct MI355X, gfx950, ROCm 7.2: two real torch GPU streams exercised workspace-key isolation and 4x-CU sizing. No NVIDIA Marlin kernel or CUDA green-context execution occurred.

remaining_counterexamples: The original mixed decode+split-prefill service sequence after a >=4K-token prefill was not executed at the candidate commit.
The candidate's deep-queue test that could expose shared-workspace Marlin spinning was skipped, so no failing-before/passing-after NVIDIA kernel result was independently obtained.
No independent evidence was obtained for other NVIDIA Marlin variants beyond source wiring; the gfx950 allocation test cannot validate their kernel synchronization behavior.
remaining_limitations: Assigned hardware is AMD Instinct MI355X (gfx950), while the issue requires NVIDIA A100/H100 CUDA green contexts and Marlin on SM80/SM90.
Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B-FP8 weights were unavailable; no full-model serving, token-equivalence, semantic-accuracy, throughput, or multi-node claim is made.
The candidate is Python-only and repository-environment.json specifies no prepared native build. No native source changed, so no native rebuild was applicable.
The source import path was confirmed as /job/repo/python/sglang; tests used the prepared interpreter /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-fa78cbfd550e/venv/bin/python.
